messages:
incident-bot:  ALERT: service=text-gen-streaming (dedicated eu-west-1) p95=940ms p99=2.9s > SLO 1.5s. Streaming stalls and tail latency observed. Queue depth +180% across two pools. Autoscaler backlog and provider allocation throttles flagged.
anya_oncall: Oncall stepping in. Paging responders. @jamie_sre lead triage. Any customer-visible failures?
jamie_sre: Joining. Root graph shows two simultaneous bursts from partner-integration:partner-x within 30s. Dedicated pool reached allocation cap, autoscaler requests queued; some warmup jobs never finished and blocked worker threads. Traces show handshake RPCs waiting on warmup init locks.
leo_ops: Provider telemetry: intermittent 429s on capacity API, slow create/attach operations. Our autoscaler retries with exponential backoff, but backlog grows because request window > backoff.
maria_runtime: Runtime traces: streaming sessions entering "pre-token" state for 5-8s before first token; once started tokens arrive fast. On new nodes we see excessive init-latency from model shard sync + KV load. Also observed ephemeral file system I/O spikes during container init.
tess_support: Customers reporting slow chat updates and occasional "sending..." stuck states. Tickets: ORG-201 (#9921), ORG-77 (#9922). CS needs ETA for update.
noah_prod: Product telemetry: partner-x uses long-running multi-turn sessions, high concurrency. They unexpectedly ramped up by 7x after integration test traffic. No per-integration caps in place.
jamie_sre: Immediate mitigations I propose: A) shift new sessions for partner-x to hosted-fallback with 60s grace; B) kick orphaned warmups and prevent scheduling new warmups until backlog drains; C) reduce warmup concurrency to 1 per host and add 20s stagger.
anya_oncall: Do A and B now. @leo_ops can you attempt quick manual add of reserved nodes and also list pending autoscaler requests?
leo_ops: Running reserve add: 
```
cloudctl reserve --region eu-west-1 --gpu-type a100 --count 6 --reason "incident 1768512345"
```
leo_ops: provider returned 429 first two attempts; third attempt accepted but provisioning time reported ~120s. Pending autoscaler queue length: 94 requests.
maria_runtime: Pushing routing rule to divert partner-x traffic: 
```
PATCH /routing/overrides
{ "match": {"integration_id":"partner-x"}, "route_to": "hosted-fallback", "ttl": 3600 }
```
maria_runtime: routing change applied. partner-x new sessions dropping to hosted in ~40s. Observed 28% reduction in dedicated ingress.
jamie_sre: Now B: cancel warmups on slow nodes. Use internal API: 
```
POST /internal/nodes/warmup/cancel { "nodes": ["node-az1-233","node-az1-240"] }
```
jamie_sre: executed. Warmup queue depth decreased ~35% in 1m. p95 for affected traffics slipped to ~640ms. p99 still ~1.5-1.9s.
leo_ops: Manual reserve nodes are provisioning now. ETA ~100s. I'll also contact provider support to escalate the 429 pattern.
maria_runtime: Additional runtime change: temporarily disable expensive shard-sync at init for reserved nodes and instead do lazy sync for non-critical prefixes. Config flip: 
```
runtime.config.warmup.sync_shards = "lazy"
runtime.config.warmup.concurrent = 1
runtime.config.warmup.stagger_seconds = 20
```
maria_runtime: applied in staging, rolling to eu-west-1.
noah_prod: Can we enable a graceful degrade: for sessions that would stream, fallback to smaller chunk sizes or short-poll for heavy partners? That reduces open-stream state.
jamie_sre: Yes, set partner-x and any suspect integration to polling-mode for 15min: 
```
feature.flags.polling_mode = ["partner-x","integration-b"]
```
tess_support: Notified impacted customers with short note: "We're seeing transient delays due to capacity provisioning. We've routed traffic and are adding capacity. ETA next update in 20 minutes."
leo_ops: Provider accepted reserves; new nodes booting. Starting health checks.
maria_runtime: While nodes boot, started targeted KV prefill for hottest keys to reduce cold miss penalty: 
```
tools/prefill_kv --region eu-west-1 --strategy top_hot --parallel 8
```
maria_runtime: prefill running; some rate-limiting observed but it's reducing misses. Cold miss rate down 60% after 90s.
jamie_sre: After warmup cancel + routing + prefill, p99 drifting down to ~1.25s. Good. Action items for mitigation window: - Keep routing override for 30m - Monitor provider API error rate - Leave warmup concurrency at 1 and stagger at 20s - Prep rollback for any config flips.
anya_oncall: Assign post-incident owners: jamie_sre (postmortem), leo_ops (vendor follow-up), maria_runtime (warmup and prefill improvements), noah_prod (rate limits and partner caps), tess_support (customer comms).
noah_prod: Also propose feature: per-integration concurrency cap and an emergency soft-fallthrough to hosted for spikes. Will draft spec.
jamie_sre: Collect traces for window 1768512200-1768513000 and node init logs. Tag events: warmup_cancel, routing_override, reserve_accept.
tess_support: Updated the two tickets with mitigation steps and ETA.
incident-bot: NOTE: incident declared: severity=P2, incident_id=INC-2026-0423-02, responders=[anya_oncall,jamie_sre,leo_ops,maria_runtime,tess_support,noah_prod]. Live mitigations applied.
anya_oncall: Handing off monitoring to follow-up shift in 90 minutes. Keep thread for postmortem notes. Good job everyone. :white_check_mark:
